name: Tailscale
description: Tailscale among the shell's VPNs: connect, log in and out, accounts, this device's name and key, exit nodes, the main switches, sharing this computer (exit node, routes, SSH server, web interface), the devices, diagnostics.

settings.label: Open Tailscale's login page in the browser
settings.hint: Off: the login link is only shown, to copy

facts.label: Tailscale sends internet traffic through an exit node

setupHints: Install Tailscale and run its service (NixOS: services.tailscale.enable = true;).
Changes ask for an administrator's password through the shell's polkit agent; making your user Tailscale's operator (offered on the module's page) asks once instead.
